author: Codex

deviations.from: Generic practical answer and 5+1+1+1 planning rubric
deviations.to: Axis-derived key, two-point gradient construction and an arrangement 1 / measurements 3 / controls 2 / table 1 / conclusion 1 rubric.
deviations.why: Claude review found reversed axes, wrong units and uncredited requested elements. Named apparatus and executable readings now match each aim.

deviations.from: Approved baseline contained no separate slots for the review-identified gaps
deviations.to: 2 explicitly identified repair items added; original slots retained.
deviations.why: Lotto requested these missing syllabus assessments. Only the contract’s derived item counts are refreshed; the approved curriculum and work-order records remain unchanged.

deviations.from: No science-specific chart renderer in the shared standard
deviations.to: Original scientific plots generated from declared numerical parameters using Matplotlib.
deviations.why: The shared chart renderer models business break-even graphs. Physics plots require the actual physical axes; no source picture or hand-edited graph is used.

deviations.from: MC set bound only to the two topic anchors
deviations.to: MC objective IDs identify the outcomes actually tested by its 12 original questions.
deviations.why: Accurate question-to-claim mapping gives wider topic practice without falsely assigning every question to two broad anchors.

deviations.from: Alternate seven/eight A-focused MC questions in the handover estimate
deviations.to: Each set uses seven knowledge questions followed by five application questions; A/B remains a proposed practice estimate.
deviations.why: The original application scenarios are retained rather than relabelled as recall. This changes the internal estimate to 182 A / 130 B over 312 questions, without changing any approved item slot, tariff or declared A/B set label.

deviations.from: Structured task bound to the two broad source anchors
deviations.to: Part-specific objective IDs match the five authored demands.
deviations.why: The original structured task tests the indicated topic outcomes; its eight-mark total and A/B practice roles remain as planned.

deviations.from: Practical task limited to its two planned anchors
deviations.to: Additional explicitly practised representation objectives are cited.
deviations.why: The actual graph/table construction meaningfully practises these outcomes as well; the slot and mark allocation are unchanged.

judgements: New scenarios, numerical values, explanations and proposed practice rubrics are authored judgements. No official stem or marking text is reproduced.
Claims remain unverified and non-publishable pending the separate human/Claude review.
